events.title: US Treasury coordinated yen intervention with Japan - first since 1998
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention on Aug 1. First US-Japan joint FX intervention since 1998. Japan dumping Treasuries to rescue yen, spilling into US debt market.

events.title: Japan unprecedented joint FX intervention with US + South Korea
events.summary: BOJ/MOF executed coordinated yen intervention with US Treasury and South Korea. Won hit 9-month high. Japan sold Treasuries to fund intervention. BOJ held rates at 1% with hawkish guidance.

events.title: South Korea joins trilateral FX intervention with US and Japan
events.summary: South Korea engaged in unprecedented joint intervention with US and Japan to support the won. Won hit 9-month high at 1,427 KRW/USD.

events.title: 2026 Iran War Day 156 - Strait of Hormuz CLOSED
events.summary: US-Israel-Iran war ongoing. Hormuz declared closed. Trump halted strike, demands reopening and nuclear rollback. Houthi Red Sea blockade diverting 6 Saudi tankers. Iran re-closed Hormuz after MOU. Kuwait drone attacks. Tanker struck.

events.title: 2026 Ebola epidemic - WHO PHEIC, Bundibugyo strain intensifying in DRC
events.summary: WHO declared PHEIC May 16 2026. Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC intensifying. 1,707+ deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. No vaccine for this strain. EU coordinating response.

events.title: Nigeria-South Africa diplomatic crisis - 116 killed in xenophobic violence
events.summary: Nigeria formally accuses SA security forces of complicity. 116 citizens killed. Diplomatic relations strained. Trade and AfCFTA at risk. Nigeria evacuating citizens.

events.title: Oil mixed as Hormuz MOU signed then broken, OPEC+ raising output
events.summary: Brent fell 5pct to ~ after US-Iran MOU, but Iran re-closed Hormuz. OPEC+ approved 188kbpd Sept increase. Houthi Red Sea blockade diverting tankers. Gold above ,148.
